errors.description: Typo in the converse display: with f(x)=x+C the middle term is (f(x)+y)/2=(x+y+C)/2, not (x+y+2C)/2. The accompanying justification ('RMS–AM–GM for the positive numbers x and y+C') is correct for the intended expression, so the logic is unaffected.

parsed.notes: Substitution x=f(y) gives f(f(y))=2f(y)-y; iteration forces d=f-id ≥0; substituting x=f(t) into both inequalities yields the verified bound |d(y)-d(t)|≤(y-t)^2/(4min{t,y}); telescoping over a fine partition gives d constant. Algebra checked line by line; all correct. Answer f(x)=x+C, C≥0, verified.
